notes: g07 labels were mostly per-file guesses. Merged objects: the objm_*/objmenu page labels (Bar, Cine, GroupPanel, CannonScreen, Panel9, Debrief, Images4, HeroModels, RewardScreen, MapPanel, Panel2, ShopScreen, Panel8, StrategicDlg, objmenu Mgr functions) are all the objective menu = CampScreen (agrees with g05/g15 mappings; g01 defines a separate ObjectiveMenu for Slider::draw_mask 0x7240f0, which is the same object). The pathmesh labels List0/List4/List8/ListC/Regions/LinkSet/PolySet/PathMesh are accessors of PfdData (likely = g16 PathSpace); IntArray and Group::recentre are TerrainBlock (path polygon). Particle labels: EffectKey = emitter definition (PartEmitter/PartBillboards aliases); ParticleKey (new) is the key base of Gauge/Emitter/RenderOp; Flag8/Kind/PartKey/Token::set_pair are ParticleKey methods. Reassigned to other groups: Player (rts2 selection, Leader/RtsGroup/Viewer/PickCursor/PlayerCtl/PlayerControl), Nation (Army morale/economy), Place (Army/Faction places.cpp + unlabelled places.cpp getters), LightSys (pick_formation), Unit (Group release/total/init/count_near, WorldObj::sync_shadow), MapObject (UnitView::update), Billboard (Light::set, set_colors), Sound3D, Listener, SoundStream (music.cpp), CutScene (i_buy Fader::update), List (Gauge::draw_6f8970), Scene (Group::set_all_df). Remaining checker reports: Group::init 0x433ea0 (g09 maps it to Group; it is not the 0x58 group) and MouseCr +0x6 (MapObject declares nothing there). Unassigned unlabelled: 0x4b0980 (modelres_pre ctor, +4/+0xc, StringPool +0xd), 0x4b9c80 (news.cpp rec_set +0x41..+0x51), 0x755840/0x755860/0x75f580/0x75f5a0 (objscr flag +0), 0x66a2e0, 0x430340/0x430370/0x4303a0 (byte getters +0x6ae/+0x4b05/+0x122), 0x67ad10 (+0x2c Range copy), 0x44cee0 (+0x10a), 0x453cc0/0x453ce0 (+0xc, +0x41/+0x42).
